timeline.tweet: Still a recurring nightmare for me 😴🤯😬!!!

Like you I had ECT. My wife says it helped a lot. I couldn’t tell. Whether due to the illness, ECT or a combo, the 6 months prior were virtually blank. Extremely disorientating, unsettling & distressing. No memory losing pills for me. Instant pass out pills on the other hand...

Sooo get this fear 💙. Weirdly confusing too. Having a ‘reason’ for feeling horrible, in my case a depression diagnosis, was a surprising relief. For others it might be their worst nightmare. Understanding & acceptance can be very tricky & elusive.

Can definitely relate! Perfectionism, at its worst, can be a relentless, fear driven, self perpetuating, self exacerbating & exhausting cycle of chasing external validation in a futile attempt to feel (temporarily) worthy. Mastery a much healthier and more productive pursuit👍

Yeah the either/or approach (& consequent infighting) troubles me. Why not both? Most? All? I get the cost could be enormous. But the cost of not doing the lot could be terrifyingly worse. Far better to do more, sooner v less, later, but hopefully more "efficiently".
